      "action": "process command continuation",
      "to": "CommandCompleted"

      "event": "cond command success",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "SendingCompletionResponse"
    },
    {
      "from": "CommandCompleted",
      "event": "cond command failure",
      "action": "reply NO",
      "to": "SendingCompletionResponse"

    {

      "action": "reply BAD",
      "to": "SendingCompletionResponse"

      "to": "AwaitingCommand"
